name: KinFlo Claude Code frame response

providerBoundary.notes: This artifact summarizes a sanitized Claude Code design critique. It does not activate hosted providers or live writes.

claudeCodeRun.promptBoundary: Sanitized product/design packet and public design research only. No secrets, private customer records, provider credentials, production data, .env contents, or raw private files were sent.

researchSources.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines
researchSources.designSignal: Use platform-grade layout, typography, controls, and accessibility fundamentals.

researchSources.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines - Layout
researchSources.designSignal: Build stable full-screen layouts first and collapse only when the full layout no longer fits.

researchSources.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines - Tab bars
researchSources.designSignal: Use tabs for peer sections and avoid overloading navigation with actions.

researchSources.name: Awwwards web design inspiration
researchSources.designSignal: Award-level web work signals object, proof, and action path quickly with high craft.

researchSources.name: Muzli dashboard inspiration
researchSources.designSignal: Dashboard inspiration should be filtered into operational hierarchy, not copied as decorative chrome.

researchSources.name: 2026 SaaS dashboard pattern research
researchSources.designSignal: Premium dashboards prioritize what matters now, progressive disclosure, and status color with meaning.

researchSources.name: 2026 SaaS website trend research
researchSources.designSignal: Current SaaS websites favor product-led surfaces, trust-first proof, clarity-led minimalism, and interactive demos.

principles.name: Object-first clarity
principles.summary: Every frame should name the active tenant, site, environment, and verification state before exposing controls.

principles.name: Gates are UI, not friction
principles.summary: Blocked actions should read as intentional trust affordances with reason, unblock path, and owner.

principles.name: Calm density, progressive proof
principles.summary: Default panels should show primary status and proof summary first, with evidence details revealed on demand.

strengths: Workflow rail plus active-object signal follows the right hierarchy.
Decision gates make the human approval posture visible.
Adapter switch evidence differentiates fixture mode from hosted readiness.
issues: Active tenant and site need stronger first-viewport identity.
Decision gates need a clearer current-blocker hierarchy.
Disabled controls need consistent reason and unblock-path copy.
Panel density needs a primary metric so scanning does not require reading every label.
Fixture-versus-hosted evidence should remain visible as operators scroll.

strengths: Device-framed preview and mobile inspection match modern site-builder patterns.
Proof-before-publish cards reinforce the trust posture.
The lane switcher now gives a stable Spin up to Configure to Handoff to Workbench progression.
issues: The selected site preview should become the visual center of gravity.
Mobile review should be persistent enough that reviewers cannot skip it accidentally.
Handoff readiness should be enumerated as criteria, not only summarized as permission status.
Proof evidence should sit nearer to the blocked publish/handoff actions.
Configuration panel affordances should be normalized across profile, permission, domain, invitation, publish, rollback, change, approval, and save panels.

providerLightDeltas.summary: Add a fixture-backed identity strip with tenant, site, environment badge, and last verified timestamp.
Introduce a shared GateCard pattern with title, state, reason blocked, unblock path, and owner.
Give each Configure panel one primary status and metric before expandable evidence detail.
Promote mobile review into a persistent 390px preview beside the desktop canvas when space allows.
Turn handoff readiness into an enumerated checklist linked to gates for profile, permissions, domain, invite, and publish evidence.

mobileRisks: Identity strip can truncate at 390px unless tenant/environment stay required and site becomes a second line.
Workflow rail and decision rail cannot both stay full-width on mobile.
Side-by-side preview must collapse below tablet width.
Gate cards can become a long scroll unless blocked cards sort first.
Evidence toggles must preserve 44px tap targets.
doNotChange: Provider-light fixture mode remains the default.
Generated Convex API imports remain blocked.
Publish action stays gated behind human approval.
Domain attachment and verification remain blocked.
Campaign sends, AI provider calls, and production imports remain blocked.
Disabled live actions remain visible with reason and unblock path.
No secrets, .env values, or provider credentials enter UI or docs.
